mapper.select: select config_value from sys_config where config_key = #{configKey} order by config_id desc limit 1
select user_id, dept_id, user_name, password, status, del_flag, pwd_update_date, credential_state, temporary_password_expires_at from sys_user where del_flag = '0' order by user_id
mapper.insert: insert into sys_credential_migration_audit (batch_id, phase, target_database, total_user_count, shared_match_count, active_shared_match_count, change_required_count, temporary_count, operator_user_id, candidate_digest, status, created_at) values (#{batchId}, #{phase}, #{targetDatabase}, #{totalUserCount}, #{sharedMatchCount}, #{activeSharedMatchCount}, #{changeRequiredCount}, #{temporaryCount}, #{operatorUserId}, #{candidateDigest}, #{status}, now())
mapper.select: select audit_id, batch_id, phase, target_database, total_user_count, shared_match_count, active_shared_match_count, change_required_count, temporary_count, operator_user_id, candidate_digest, status, created_at from sys_credential_migration_audit where batch_id = #{batchId} and phase = 'ROTATION_PREVIEW' limit 1
mapper.update: update sys_user set password = #{password}, credential_state = 'TEMPORARY', temporary_password_expires_at = #{expiresAt}, pwd_update_date = null, status = '1', update_by = concat('uid:', #{operatorUserId}), update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
